subject: seal
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: seal, in the place of the game's models/player/seal/seal.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/player/agent/agent.mdl, models/player/terrorist/terrorist.mdl, models/player/castor/castor.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, C, B, D where the asset was C, D, A, C: passed for one of the game's
measured.contract: keeps the contract the mod's stock players share: their animations at their numbers, their shared bones, attachments and bodyparts

M1.reason: Outline matches the brief's words: an upright operator with a balaclava head, a vest over a jacket, gloved hands, fatigue trousers and two laced boots, at natural proportions in the front, left, back and right views. Nothing sticks out or is missing in any of the six views.

M2.reason: Height is 70.1 against the brief's 70 (0.1% off), within 15%. Length 23.9 and width 24.5 are not sized by the brief, so they are not charged.

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, checked one by one: balaclava (head, front and back views), dark vest (back view and right view), vest pouches (chest and side pouches in the front and front-right views), gloves (black hands in front, back and below views), fatigue jacket and trousers (tan), two boots (left and right in every view). Small pouch counts are hard to confirm at this scale, but none is visibly missing. Knee pads and a back emblem are extras the brief does not ask for and do not count against it.

M4.reason: Dark vest, tan fatigues, black balaclava, black gloves and black boots, each region a plausible match for what the brief describes. The silver knee pads read as painted metal. No region looks off in colour or material.

M5.reason: Surface detail is present and sensible: a silver winged emblem on the back of the vest, silver knee pads, vest straps and seams, boot laces. The brief asks for none of this, and it adds nothing wrong. The red eye glow in the balaclava in the front-right view is a small paint quirk and does not change the outline.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 here by the rule that M6 is measured apart. The line-up test (asset at C, D, A, C across four runs; judges picked A, C, B, D) caught it 0 of 4 times, so it passed for one of the game's. Scored 2 as the rule requires.

M7.reason: Front faces the camera in the front view and is upright. Feet sit on the floor in the side and front-left views, consistent with standing on its origin.

M8.reason: SMAK's checks return no errors. Triangles 2617 is under the limit of 3018 (twice the Half-Life median of 1509 is 3018, which is more than the three-quarter mark of 1733). Nothing visibly open, inside out or floating in the below, top and back-left views.

C1.reason: Run frames 0/30 to 30/30 show arms, legs, boots and knee pads moving with the body, nothing detached or floating. The shoot_onehanded frames keep the vest, arms and legs together. The dive_f_akimbo frames (0/35 to 35/35) keep limbs attached through the flight and the flat landing. Scale is small, so fine detail is limited.

C2.reason: The measurement record states the model keeps the stock player contract (animations at their numbers, shared bones, attachments and bodyparts). Scored 2 on that measure; I did not see the compareContract output itself.
